senses.gloss: pr. n.Beth-Yazek, name of a court in Jerusalem where the witnesses for ascertaining the New Moon were heard.
units: <cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 23b:9">Ib. 23ᵇ</cite> question as to <cite ref="J00481"><he>יעזק</he></cite> (as a denom. of <he>עזק</he>) or <cite ref="J00266"><he>יָזֵק</he></cite> (as a denom. of <he>זקק</he>).
